title: Malta
text: Malta, officially the Republic of Malta, is an island country located in the central Mediterranean Sea. It consists of two main islands, Malta and Gozo, which are 80 km (50 mi) south of Italy, 284 km (176 mi) east of Tunisia, and 333 km (207 mi) north of Libya. The two official languages are Maltese and English; Maltese is recognised as the national language. The country's capital is Valletta.
